KW V4 is a premium, three-way adjustable coilover suspension made from stainless steel, designed for high-performance vehicles. Key Features:
– Rebound damping: 16 precise clicks
– Low-speed compression: 6 precise clicks
– High-speed compression: 14 precise clicks
– Stepless height adjustment
– Stainless steel construction
– Two basic settings: comfort and performance

Control:
The three-way adjustment allows for individual tuning of the vehicle's behavior in smooth corners (low-speed), when encountering bumps (high-speed), and for controlling body roll (rebound). Designed for super sports cars where maximum control is required.

Part Number: 3A771095
